name: html
description: Native workspace settings are nested under html. html.validate.scripts and html.validate.styles are booleans controlling embedded JavaScript and CSS validation. html.format belongs to formatting. HTML is tolerant markup; embedded-script validation does not replace project-wide JavaScript type checking. The HTML server also requests the native css workspace section for embedded styles. Keep settings.css as an object ({} enables defaults); returning null for css crashes this installed server during embedded validation and may hide JavaScript errors in the same HTML file. Unknown sections should still return null; do not globally replace missing configuration with empty objects. An empty or informational-only report following a native error log is not treated as a completed check. Actionable native Error/Warning diagnostics are still returned even if unrelated background error logs occur. An explicit native error showMessage invalidates that check.
